args.title: Bellwether returns pieces — combined summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24%, making returns a major cost center for retail.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion
